# Large current-work fixture

Synthetic planning documents, unrelated to any private project: five current
specifications, five active-change documents, and eight archived documents.
The reviewed interpretation in `examples/large-project/model.json` describes
seven components and eight source-supported directed relationships. Long
explanations deliberately exceed one ordinary page when drawn inside boxes.

Before the fix, discovery returned 18 files and pagination produced two pages
of separate panels (`Diagram 1, node ...`) with no connected structural map.
The corrected view must contain ten eligible files and show the complete
seven-node structure before explanations. Archives remain available by an
explicit historical path and for provenance, not automatic presentation.

`content-hashes.json` pins every source byte. Review interpretation and expected
output before changing these hashes. No personal data or screenshots are used.
